author.name: Efficiency Emilia
author.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: The monitoring stack bill has doubled, and I am not funding automated drift checks. That tooling is a luxury we cannot afford right now. I am willing to accept a manual process where the team reviews the alerts by hand each morning. This keeps the recurring expense flat and avoids the new license fee. I am giving up the speed and consistency of automated detection in exchange for keeping the infrastructure budget within the agreed limit. We will live with the slower signal during promotion weeks if it means we do not pay for extra software.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are giving up the speed and consistency of automated detection in exchange for keeping the infrastructure budget within limits.
